def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    qualified_expenses = 8500.0
    magi = 85000.0
    phase_out_start = 80000.0
    phase_out_end = 90000.0
    credit_rate = 0.20

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    potential_credit = min(qualified_expenses, 10000.0) * credit_rate
    phase_out_percentage = (phase_out_end - magi) / (
        phase_out_end - phase_out_start
    )
    answer = potential_credit * phase_out_percentage

    # return answer
    return round(answer, 2)
